svg.title: The three pieces of a StateGraph, drawn as a kitchen. Nodes are stations: Python functions that each do one job. Edges are the route the ticket takes from START through each node to END. The state is the order ticket: one shared record every node reads, and each node returns an update that is written back onto it.
